_comment: Theaters in narrative-density order (a display coordinate, not a taxonomy — reorderable at runtime afterward). Pivots are the plan's default set; eras derive as the gaps between them. No subject or plot point is assigned to a theater by this op — everything starts at '(Unplaced)' and moving it is authorial work done in the app.

pivots.description: Ocean travel connects the continents; from here the world is causal and isolationism is a myth.
